The registration app lives in `openmrs-esm-patient-management` under `packages/esm-patient-registration-app`. Falkon has no separate registration repo.

**Why it over-consumed identifiers:** Before the fix, `savePatientIdentifiers` called `generateIdentifier(selectedSource.uuid)` (which POSTs to `/idgen/identifiersource/{source}/identifier`) every time it ran for an auto-generated identifier field. The diff for `b4b76423` shows the old code as a bare `await generateIdentifier(...)` inside the map, with no record of earlier results. If a first save partly completed and then failed, a retry issued a fresh value for each auto-generated field. The values from the earlier attempt were already issued by the source but never used. For an existing patient, identifiers that had already been added were also posted again on retry.

**The fix:** Commit `b4b76423` ("(fix) O3-5916: Reuse generated identifiers when retrying a patient save (#2780)", by Dennis Kigen). It adds a `SavePatientTransactionManager` that lives for one submission and holds:
- `generatedIdentifiers`, keyed by field name, so a retry reuses the value for the same source instead of calling the idgen endpoint again.
- `addedIdentifiers`, so an identifier already added to an existing patient is not posted again.

The commit subject and diff are the evidence I checked. I did not read the PR description, so the PR-level rationale is not confirmed beyond the title.
